content:
Since \(x>0\), let
\[
t=\log_{2026}x,
\]
so that
\[
x=2026^t.
\]
Then
\[
\sqrt[20]{x^{\log_{2026}x}}
=\sqrt[20]{(2026^t)^t}
=2026^{t^2/20}.
\]
The equation becomes
\[
2026^{t^2/20}=26\cdot 2026^t.
\]
Taking \(\log_{2026}\) of both sides gives
\[
\frac{t^2}{20}=t+\log_{2026}26,
\]
or
\[
t^2-20t-20\log_{2026}26=0.
\]

This quadratic has two distinct real roots because its discriminant is positive. If the roots are \(t_1,t_2\), then by Vieta's formulas,
\[
t_1+t_2=20.
\]
The corresponding positive values of \(x\) are \(2026^{t_1}\) and \(2026^{t_2}\). Their product is therefore
\[
2026^{t_1+t_2}=2026^{20}.
\]

Now
\[
2026=2\cdot 1013,
\]
where \(1013\) is prime. Hence
\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot1013^{20},
\]
which has
\[
(20+1)(20+1)=21^2=441
\]
positive divisors.

\[
\boxed{441}
\]
